Content collections

A folder under content/ is a collection. content/posts/*.md is posts, reachable in any template as collections.posts.

Give it a form by declaring schemas/posts.json:

{
  "label": "Posts",
  "fields": [
    { "id": "title", "type": "text", "label": "Title" },
    { "id": "date", "type": "date", "label": "Date" },
    { "id": "tags", "type": "tags", "label": "Tags" }
  ]
}

The same field vocabulary a section's <schema> uses, which is why one component in the dashboard renders both a section setting and a post's date.

Each item renders through templates/<singular>.json — posts through post.json — falling back to page.json. Set template: in a file's frontmatter to override it for that item.
